title: The Present of Architectural Psychology Researches in China- Based on the Bibliometric Analysis and Knowledge Mapping
review_question: What is the current state of architectural psychology research in China, including publishing trends, key contributors (journals and organizations), popular keywords, and research frontiers, based on bibliometric analysis?
inclusion_exclusion_criteria: 129 relevant papers (117 journal articles and 12 dissertations) were included from an initial search of 142 published papers of all types in the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) database. Irrelevant articles were excluded.

findings.consequent: Annual number of architectural psychology papers published in China
findings.quote: The annual number of the papers increased dramatically from 2008 and reached a historical peak in 2016.

findings.consequent: Contribution to architectural psychology research in China (number of articles published)
findings.quote: Shanxi Architecture tops the list with a total of 11 articles, followed by Doors and Windows, World Architecture and Journal of Architectural Education in Institutions of Higher Learning, each of which published 4 articles.

findings.consequent: Contribution to architectural psychology research in China (number of articles published)
findings.quote: Wuhan University, Southwest Jiaotong University and Chongqing University all published 5 articles and ranked at the top of the Contributing organizations list...

findings.consequent: Frequency of appearance in architectural psychology papers in China
findings.quote: “Environmental Psychology", "Architectural Design" and "Architectural Psychology" are the most frequency keywords...

findings.antecedent: Research topic (keywords with strongest citation bursts)
findings.consequent: Identification of research frontiers in architectural psychology in China
findings.quote: “architectural creation" was began 1988 to 1991 while “environmental psychology" was began 2011 to 2015.

findings.antecedent: Research topic clusters (Modularity Q=0.885, Mean Silhouette=0.863)
findings.consequent: Identification of popular research topics in architectural psychology in China
findings.quote: The top five largest clusters are “residential environment”, “spatial environment”, “environmental psychology”, “architectural theory" and "architectural psychology" respectively.

synthesis_conclusions: Architectural psychology research in China began in 1984, with a dramatic increase in publications from 2008, peaking in 2016.
Shanxi Architecture is the leading journal, and Wuhan University, Southwest Jiaotong University, and Chongqing University are the top contributing organizations.
The most frequent keywords are "Environmental Psychology", "Architectural Design", and "Architectural Psychology".
Research frontiers have shifted from "architectural creation" (1988-1991) to "environmental psychology" (2011-2015).
Key research clusters include "residential environment", "spatial environment", "environmental psychology", "architectural theory", and "architectural psychology".
evidence_gaps: Future research could present research topics by years and provide new insights through timeline analysis.
Future research could compare architectural psychology research between China and developed countries to inform Chinese researchers.
